title: Very Nice Crockpot, But Not Really Programmable
text:
Very Nice Crockpot, But Not Really Programmable. We use crock pots in our house almost weekly for the convenience and for their ability to tenderize meats. I have used mostly Rival and Hamilton Beach crock pots but I am familiar with several other brands, but Bella is a brand which which I was previously unfamiliar. My impression of this crock pot is positive, but it is not programmable as it has been advertised.

Most crockpots have either two or three temperature settings - warm, low and high. The Bella crockpot has three, and all of these work as one would expect. There's no rocket science here - the element heats the ceramic liner to a specific temperature and maintains that temperature through cooking.

This is an easy to use crockpot that heats nicely and does a good job. It seems to cook at proper temperatures and it does not get too hot to touch on the surface. The lid fits nicely too, which is a plus. Things we have made with this crock pot have turned out right so far.

This particular is touted as being programmable, but it isn't. Instead, it has digital settings control with a built in countdown timer. So, for example you can set it to cook on low for 8 hours through the use of some button settings. When the time is up, the crock put turns off completely. The programmable crock pots I have seen switch to the warm setting after the time is up, which makes better sense. Any advantage to having a digital control is lost if it is unable to change modes automatically.

Another oversight in the controls is that there is no notification that the time is up. A sound alerting the user that it has completed the cycle would be a nice thing if it's not going to change modes, but this is not there either. So, a user must be conscious of when the crock pot is actually going to finish. This really defeats the whole purpose of having a timer on it, and it actually is a negative. If the user isn't aware of when it cuts off, there may be cold food waiting for dinner.

This is a decent crock pot and it looks nice. Some real thought went into the design of the appliance and the digital controls are easy to use. It is unfortunate that the timer and programmability aspects just aren't there for the user. If you want a programmable crock pot, look for other options. If you don't mind keeping track of cooking times and paying attention to how much time is left on the timer, this is not a bad device.

features: Stoneware pot and tempered glass lid are dishwasher safe
Large 5QT capacity fits various sized meals
description: With its unique dot texture, gorgeous colors and sleek design BELLA Dots will bring life to your kitchen and make you smile. Pick your meal, set the dial and walk away knowing that your countertop is working in style. Set the timer for 30 minutes or 30 hours and watch the Slow Cooker Countdown to food completion. Keep your food warm or reheat with low, high and warm settings. Feed your family and friends with a large 5QT capacity that fits various sized meals. The BELLA Dots Programmable Slow Cooker is unique and colorful. Just like you.
Stoneware pot and tempered glass lid are dishwasher safe
Stoneware pot and tempered glass lid are dishwasher safe

With the Dots 5-Quart Programmable Slow Cooker, it's easy to create healthy, great-tasting meals with meats, vegetables, and grains. The stoneware pot provides plenty of space to assemble ingredients hours before you plan to eat. The 30-minute-to-20-hour digital countdown timer ensures your meal will be perfectly cooked when you want it. One-pot cooking also makes for less mess and fewer dirty dishes to clean.
Seals in Moisture to Increase Flavor

Thanks to its tempered-glass lid, the cooker seals in flavor by locking in moisture, so even tougher cuts of meat become tender and delicious. Vegetables and grains absorb the rich flavors of stocks and seasoning.

The slow cooker can operate at the low setting all day or night, meaning you can put ingredients in the pot in the morning and come home at the end of the day to a fully cooked meal. Foods will cook on high in about half the time required for low cooking. When cooking is complete, the warm setting will keep the food at the perfect temperature for up to four hours. It's easy to try new dishes--experimenting with curry, enchiladas, bread pudding, and more is as simple as throwing in the ingredients and walking away.
Removable Pot for Easy Serving and Cleaning
When it's time to serve your meal, the pot lifts out of the slow cooker, so you can bring it directly to the table. For easy cleaning, both the pot and the tempered-glass lid are dishwasher safe.
Featuring a unique dot texture, gorgeous colors and sleek design, BELLA Dots adds style to your kitchen. To keep the finish looking great, wipe clean after use.
This slow cooker uses less energy than most ovens, making it a more eco-sensitive cooking choice.
